title: REQ · A pure helper reports phaser versions that are not 3.90.x
summary: phaserPinProblems returns a list of problems for package.json and lockfile objects
description: Context: no reusable check exists for the phaser pin. Desired behavior: a pure function takes parsed package.json and lockfile objects and returns an array of human-readable problems. Expected result: empty array for 3.90.x everywhere, non-empty for any 4.x or mismatch. Why: lets a regression be proven to fail without editing real files.
acceptance_criteria: Given pkg.dependencies.phaser '~3.90.0' and a lock with root specifier '~3.90.0' and node_modules/phaser version '3.90.0', when called, then it returns []
Given pkg.dependencies.phaser '^4.2.1' or lock version '4.2.1', when called, then the returned array names the offending field

out_of_scope: Reading files from disk in the helper
